exposure: use of RobsApp for data collection
indications for Caesarean section (e.g., CTG abnormalities)
cohort: The study included 1,712 deliveries at the Professorial Unit of De Soysa Hospital for Women (DSHW), Sri Lanka, from April to October 2019.
finding: RobsApp proved to be an effective tool for high-quality prospective data collection on Caesarean section rates according to Robson guidelines, revealing an overall Caesarean section rate of 33.0% at DSHW.
mod_finding: The overall Caesarean section rate was 33.0%, with Robson category 5a (previous Caesarean section) accounting for most cases, and emergency Caesarean sections (49.6%) primarily due to cardiotocograph abnormalities.
